lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: You knocked the Rumble Golem flat! The whole canyon felt it. My tea did too.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Welcome to Sunscorch Canyon! Mind the quicksand, it's slower than a sleepy cactus.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Three Star Shards open the Golem Gate to the south: one on the mesas, one past the quicksand, one in the old ruins.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Oh, and if you ever learn to make fire... those thorny brambles hide all sorts of things.
